description: This PHP class 'JobTitleDao' provides data access methods for managing job titles and related entities within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of job titles and attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for JobTitle and related entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and queries.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active job titles, optionally filtering only active ones.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves job titles associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Retrieves job titles based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for job titles based on search filters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of job titles matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a job title by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing job titles from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a job specification attachment by its ID.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves partial job specification attachment info for a given job title ID.
